profile_rules.vehicle: Preserve raw normalized source evidence for ordinary operational specialization without new formulas or runtime behavior.
profile_rules.mecha: Preserve frame/class, mobility, EP/energy, interface, modules, sensors and shields; source-absent heat remains unresolved.
profile_rules.ship: Preserve class/scale/hull, shields, FTL, hangar evidence, hardpoints, power, reactor/fuel and endurance; life-support capacity remains unresolved without a dedicated source field; detailed power grid remains PPIA-04-deferred.
profile_rules.base: Use existing MIB-14 base definitions for owner-backed configuration and reference-only facility evidence; universal habitation remains unresolved through SMB-05's explicit housing seam.

provenance_rules: Missing fields remain source-unspecified with defaultApplied=false.
Raw source units/text are preserved; OARC-04 does not silently parse them into new mechanical units.
Facility evidence does not imply installation.
Owner-backed MIB-14 numeric fields remain distinct from normalized source facts.
forbidden_behavior: invented heat, life-support or habitation defaults
representative_cases: MIB-14 Workshop Outpost with Mecha Workshop reference evidence
future_handoff: OARC-05 may prove explicit containment and large-asset relationships using existing Asset/containment owners. Specialization profiles do not create containment ownership or live relationship state.
